name: Absolute Direction
description: You always know which way is north and can recall any direction you have moved in. Useful for navigation through treacherous territories.

name: Absolute Timing
description: You always know the precise time without needing a clock. Valuable for coordinating precise ambushes or meeting illicit contacts.

name: Acute Senses
description: Your sense of Smell, Taste, Touch, Vision, or Hearing is exceptionally sharp. (+1 per level).

name: Altered Time Rate
description: You perceive and react to the world much faster than normal.

name: Ally
description: You have a loyal friend or group who will help you. Cost varies based on power and frequency.

name: Alternate Identity
description: You have a legally established false identity. Cost is 5 for a basic ID, 15 for a well-established one.

name: Ambidexterity
description: You are equally skilled with both hands, suffering no off-hand penalty. Allows for versatile combat and multi-tasking.

name: Animal Empathy
description: You have a natural rapport with non-sentient creatures.

name: Appearance
description: Your physical attractiveness. Can be increased. (Attractive [4], Stunning [20])

name: Catfall
description: You have an innate ability to land on your feet and reduce falling damage.

name: Charisma
description: You are naturally charming and persuasive, gaining bonuses to reaction rolls and influence skills. Can be taken in levels.

name: Claim to Hospitality
description: A specific culture or group is honor-bound to provide you with food and shelter. Cost varies.

name: Closure
description: You are excellent at solving puzzles and seeing patterns with incomplete information.

name: Combat Reflexes
description: You react quickly to threats. +1 to initiative, faster recovery from surprise, and extra defense rolls.

name: Common Sense
description: The GM will warn you if you are about to do something foolish or dangerous.

name: Compartmentalized Mind
description: You can maintain multiple separate trains of thought simultaneously.

levels.description: Can maintain two separate trains of thought.

name: Composed
description: You are unusually calm under pressure, gaining a bonus to Fright Checks and resistance to mental attacks.

name: Contact
description: You have an informant who can provide information. Cost varies.

name: Contact Group
description: You have access to a network of contacts. Cost varies.

name: Core World Diplomat/Aristocrat
description: Wealth (Comfortable), Status 1, +1 Diplomacy, +1 Savoir-Faire.

name: Cultural Adaptability
description: You quickly learn and adapt to new cultures and social norms, reducing penalties for cultural unfamiliarity.

name: Danger Sense
description: You possess an instinctive ability to detect impending threats or danger. The GM will secretly roll against your Perception.

name: Doesn't Breathe
description: You do not need to breathe. Standard for droids.

name: Double-Jointed
description: You are incredibly flexible, granting bonuses to escape bonds.

name: Eidetic Memory
description: You have perfect recall of everything you have ever seen or heard.

name: Enhanced Defenses
description: Improves your ability to defend against attacks. Includes Parry, Block, and Dodge. Cost is per level for a specific defense.

name: Enhanced Move
description: You move much faster than your Basic Move would indicate.

name: Enhanced Time Sense
description: You perceive time at an accelerated rate, allowing you to move and react much faster. Grants extra actions or significant defensive bonuses.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can make an additional attack in a single turn.

name: Fearlessness
description: You are more resistant to fear and intimidation. Each level grants a bonus to Fright Checks.

name: Fit
description: You are unusually robust and healthy, with bonuses to EP recovery and resistance to illness.

name: Force Perception
description: Enhanced ability to perceive and interpret the Force. +1 to Sense per level.

levels.description: +1 to Sense rolls for Force phenomena.

name: Force Sensitive
description: You can feel the Force. Prerequisite for all Force-related abilities.

name: Force Training
description: Represents dedicated instruction in the ways of the Force.

levels.description: Unlocks Adept tier Force Powers and grants +1 max FP.
Unlocks Expert tier Force Powers and grants an additional +1 max FP (total +2).
Unlocks Master tier Force Powers and grants an additional +2 max FP (total +4).

name: Gizmo
description: You have a knack for pulling exactly the right small item out of nowhere at a critical moment. Can be taken in levels.

name: High Pain Threshold
description: You are unusually resistant to the effects of pain, suffering fewer penalties from injury.

name: Higher Purpose
description: You are dedicated to a single, lofty goal, gaining a +1 to any roll that directly advances this cause.

name: Indomitable
description: You have an unbreakable will, gaining a bonus to resist mental attacks and persuasion.

name: Injury Tolerance
description: You lack certain vulnerable parts or are harder to injure. Cost varies.

name: Intuition
description: You have a knack for guessing correctly without conscious reasoning; the GM will give you occasional insights.

name: Language Talent
description: You have a natural aptitude for learning languages, gaining a bonus to language-related skill rolls.

name: Legal Enforcement Powers
description: You possess the authority to enforce laws. Point value varies by scope.

name: Legal Immunity
description: You are immune to prosecution by certain legal authorities. Cost varies.

name: Lifting ST
description: Your strength for lifting and carrying is greater than your striking strength.

name: Literacy
description: You can read and write in your native language.

name: Longevity
description: You age more slowly than others of your species. Can be taken in levels.

levels.description: Age at half the normal rate.

name: Luck
description: You are unusually fortunate; the GM will occasionally give you rerolls or favorable circumstances.

name: Extraordinary Luck
description: You are extremely fortunate; the GM will give you more rerolls.

name: Mandalorian Combat Aptitude
description: +1 DX, +1 to two combat skills, Composed, High Pain Threshold.

name: Military Rank
description: You hold an official rank in a military organization, granting authority. Cost is 5 points per rank level.

name: Night Vision
description: You can see in low-light conditions, reducing darkness penalties.

name: Patron
description: A powerful individual or organization provides you with aid. Cost varies.

name: Payload
description: You have internal storage space for carrying objects discreetly.

name: Perfect Balance
description: You have an extraordinary sense of balance, making you very difficult to knock down.

name: Peripheral Vision
description: You have a 360-degree field of vision, making it impossible to surprise you from behind.

name: Pressure Support
description: You can survive in high or low-pressure environments without special equipment.

name: Rapid Healing
description: You recover from injury more quickly than average.

name: Regeneration
description: You heal from injuries at an astonishing rate. (25pts for Slow, 50 for Fast, 75 for Very Fast)

name: Regrowth
description: You can regrow lost limbs and organs over time.

name: Reputation
description: Your renown (good or bad) within a specific group. Point cost varies.

name: Republic Military Discipline
description: Fearlessness, Sense of Duty (Republic), +1 Leadership, +1 Tactics.

name: Resistant
description: You are unusually resistant to a specific type of hazard. Cost varies.

name: Sealed
description: Your body is a closed system, allowing you to survive in a vacuum or underwater without a suit.

name: Security Clearance
description: You have official permission to access secret information or restricted locations. Cost varies.

name: Sensitive
description: You can sense strong supernatural phenomena, though you cannot use powers yourself.

name: Serendipity
description: You have an uncanny knack for being in the right place at the right time. Cost is per level.

name: Signature Gear
description: You own a specific piece of equipment that is particularly reliable or useful. Point cost varies.

name: Single-Minded
description: You gain a +1 bonus to any task that requires more than an hour of concentration.

name: Social Chameleon
description: You are skilled at blending into new social situations, quickly negating penalties for cultural unfamiliarity.

name: Status
description: You have high social standing, affecting reaction rolls. Cost is 5 points per level.

name: Talent
description: You have a natural aptitude for a group of related skills. Cost varies.

name: Temperature Tolerance
description: You are comfortable in a wider range of extreme temperatures than normal.

name: Underworld Savvy
description: Contacts (Criminal), +1 Streetwise, +1 Scrounging, Intuition.

name: Unfazeable
description: You are immune to mundane surprise and mentally unshakable when faced with horrific sights.

name: Very Fit
description: You are exceptionally robust and healthy, with greater bonuses than Fit.

name: Very Rapid Healing
description: You heal from injuries much faster.

name: Voice
description: You have a remarkable voice, granting a +2 to reaction rolls and some social skills.

name: Wealth
description: Your financial resources. Ranges from Comfortable (10) to Filthy Rich (30).

name: Weapon Master
description: You are exceptionally skilled with a specific weapon type. Cost varies by scope (20-45 points).

name: Zeroed
description: You have no official records. To the galaxy at large, you do not exist.
